name: Iso-Lateral Row
source: Official Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row demonstration video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VZmJ8z6zh3g, static level side view across full ROM from full stretch to peak contraction, 5 poses at t=18.3s, 17.9s, 17.6s, 17.4s, 17.1s ordered start-to-finish). Single-arm near workarm modeled with 70 lb (31.75 kg) added plates (1x45 lb + 1x25 lb); pivot verified by 50/50 motion overlay and concentric-circle fit (<1 px grip radius spread).

observation.evidence: Official Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Row demonstration video (YouTube ID VZmJ8z6zh3g, static level side view; 5 frames ordered from 0% full stretch to 100% peak contraction: f_019, f_015, f_012, f_010, f_007 at 10 fps from t=16.5s). Modeled assembly is the near-side (left) independent rigid lever arm rotating clockwise around the upper pivot bearing axle [504, 591] (verified by 50/50 start/finish ghost overlay and concentric-circle fit: grip radius 234.2-235.9 px across 52 deg full sweep, plate radius 132.8-138.3 px). Added load on the moving lower-front horn is one 45 lb + one 25 lb plate (70 lb = 31.75 kg). Grip is the athlete's left hand on the vertical neutral handle. Compound multi-joint horizontal pull; anatomical joint fields omitted.

base_resistance.source: Hammer Strength specifies 12 lbs (5.4 kg) starting resistance per workarm for the Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Row (IL-ROW). Its variation across travel is unknown; the default holds this force constant.
